ideas.pitch: An agentic multimodal telemetry analyzer that cross-references satellite imagery, raw time-series sensor data, and technical manuals to diagnose anomalies in space hardware.
ideas.problem_statement: Space research domain: Building solutions that accelerate research or solve overlooked operational bottlenecks using multimodal reasoning.
ideas.title: AstroMultimodal-Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Space track which has fewer direct competitors, and features a live working demo ingesting multi-format data streams like GeoNex-ATLAS did for industrial monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal laboratory assistant that processes microscopy imagery, lab protocol text documents, and assay spreadsheets to guide researchers and flag experimental deviations.
ideas.problem_statement: BioTech domain: Creating tools that accelerate research or improve operational workflows in biotechnology.
ideas.title: BioVision-LabAssistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the BioTech track with a verticalised AI workflow, avoiding generic chat apps and delivering genuinely hard engineering across disparate modalities.

ideas.pitch: An agentic multi-modal tutoring platform that converts static textbook diagrams and mathematical problem text into interactive, personalized step-by-step reasoning paths for students.
ideas.problem_statement: Education domain: Designing solutions that improve access to learning and comprehension using multimodal systems.
ideas.title: EduAdapt-MultiAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a multi-agent educational pipeline with strong UI accessibility, mirroring winning patterns from agentic student support platforms.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery analysis tool that identifies orbital debris vectors and ground infrastructure risks by combining geospatial visual models with atmospheric telemetry logs.
ideas.problem_statement: Space research domain: Applying multimodal AI systems to reason across text, images, and data for space exploration and safety.
ideas.title: OrbitVision-HazardMap
ideas.why_it_could_win: Executes a high-impact computer vision and data fusion task that judges in the Space track can immediately evaluate via a live visual dashboard.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal retrieval-augmented generation engine that correlates genomic sequence data charts with medical literature PDFs to surface clinical research hypotheses.
ideas.problem_statement: BioTech domain: Building specialised tools that bridge unstructured documents and complex analytical data sets in life sciences.
ideas.title: BioSeq-Insights
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a heavy data integration problem with clean RAG architecture and a robust evaluation metric benchmark, aligning with rigorous hackathon win criteria.
